headline: Instagram adds Amazon affiliate links to Reels and posts
summary: Instagram now lets creators attach Amazon affiliate links directly within Reels and feed posts, extending a feature previously limited to stories, DMs and bios, with the rollout arriving ahead of the Black Friday shopping season.

claims.statement: Instagram now lets creators add Amazon affiliate links directly to Reels and feed posts.

sources.quote: Instagram Is Bringing Amazon Affiliate Links Directly to Reels and Posts
Instagram will let creators add Amazon affiliate links directly to their posts and Reels
Instagram now lets creators add Amazon affiliate links in reels and feed posts

claims.statement: Creators can attach up to 30 affiliate links per Reel.

sources.quote: lets creators attach up to 30 affiliate links per Reel

claims.statement: The feature rolled out ahead of Black Friday.

sources.quote: just in time for Black Friday
